notes: Multi Studio version 3.1.0: **SRT Block Extractor**: Introduced a dedicated workspace module to automatically detect and extract SRT subtitle blocks from markdown story scripts and video production notes. Instead of tedious manual copy-pasting block by block, you can now drag-and-drop or import any script file to extract every subtitle block in seconds., **Smart Scene & Heading Number Matching**: Automatically inspects script headings and pairs each subtitle block with its closest scene section. Documents structured with scene headers (such as "Scene 01", "Scene 02") can instantly name each exported file by its scene number (e.g., `01.srt.md`, `02.srt.md`), while unnumbered sections like "Conclusion" smoothly use their section title., **Flexible Filename Schemes & Inline Customization**: Switch effortlessly between **Heading Number**, **Heading Title**, **Sequential Ordering** (01, 02, 03...), or custom naming templates. You can also click and edit any individual block's filename directly inside the list to give specific scenes custom names., **Scriber-Consistent Batch Export & Consolidated Format Choices**: Modeled after the AI Scriber export experience, download all extracted subtitle blocks in a single ZIP archive, export individual scene files (`.srt.md`, `.srt`, `.md`, or `.txt`), or generate a combined master subtitle file. Output formats are cleanly consolidated into a single dedicated selector in the Export menu to prevent confusing duplicate controls., **Continuous Calculated Timestamps & Configurable Block Gaps for Combined Subtitles**: Added an intelligent timeline calculator for combined exports. Because individual scenes in script notes each start from 00:00:00,000, combining them naively causes all subtitles to overlap from the start. Enabling "Calculate Continuous Timestamps" automatically offsets each subsequent scene by the total elapsed duration of previous scenes and maintains sequential cue numbers (1, 2, 3...) across the whole file. You can also specify an exact gap between consecutive scenes (such as 2s or 3s) using quick preset buttons (`0s`, `+1s`, `+2s`, `+3s`, `+5s`) or typing a custom duration in seconds, creating a seamless master timeline perfectly spaced for scene transitions in video editors (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut)., **Document Structure Health Analyzer & Explainer Guide**: A visual health indicator checks your document structure in real-time, reporting matched subtitle blocks, detected scene numbers, and empty sections. A rich Explainer Guide provides new users with clear visual walkthroughs of supported markdown patterns, naming rules, and export choices., **Full App-Restart State & Panel Persistence**: Automatically saves your loaded script text, file name, custom filename overrides, and resizable split-panel dimensions. Quitting or restarting the desktop app seamlessly restores your entire workspace exactly as you left it without panel conflicts., **Effortless Card-Click Subtitle Expansion**: Click anywhere on a scene card to expand or collapse its subtitle cue snippet instantly without being forced to click the small chevron button., **Enhanced Smaller Screen Responsiveness**: All toolbar actions, naming pill buttons, and scene card rows adapt smoothly on compact laptops and smaller displays with zero layout clipping or horizontal overflow., **Silent Feedback & Minimized Toast Notifications**: Dramatically reduced intrusive toast alerts across the workspace. Quick copy actions now display an instant in-place visual checkmark directly on the button rather than triggering a toast popup, and routine typing or text updates operate silently. Toast messages are now reserved strictly for genuine error alerts and batch export completions.
